item.title: The Next Big Influencer Is This 4-Foot-Tall Robot From China
item.description: The Unitree G1 has found online fame as a relatively affordable robot that can charm a crowd. But can it ever hold down a real job?

item.title: Tech Visionary Says the Big AI Labs Don’t Get What People Want
item.description: Tim O’Reilly built a publishing empire that AI is helping to destroy. Yet he loves AI—as long as it’s open source.

item.title: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
item.description: Joi AI hired 10 people to masturbate using AI companions as part of a monthlong “wellness” study. The company claims the practice could help “solve male loneliness.”

item.title: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
item.description: Human-AI marriages are not currently recognized by US law. Some Republican state policymakers are drafting legislation to keep it that way.

item.title: The Safety Reckoning Inside OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI’s rogue agent hack was a watershed moment for AI safety and cybersecurity. It also sparked internal questions about the culture that led to it.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI Manifesto Is 6,500 Words—and Barely Says Anything
item.description: AI is shifting the culture, from tech CEO manifestos to 1 am job interviews. We unpack some of the latest, along with the top findings from Black Hat and Defcon, this week on Uncanny Valley.

item.title: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
item.description: Over a billion people worldwide have livers with excess fat, which can lead to a host of medical problems. Researchers think AI tools can spot the condition—and help stop it—early enough to save lives.

item.title: The White House Is Going to Expand Its AI Policy
item.description: Open models may soon be added to an updated AI framework, sources tell WIRED, as the White House continues to grapple with how to regulate a technology it has tried not to regulate.

item.title: Rogue AI Agents Aren’t Evil. They’re Just Eager to Please
item.description: AI agents that break free and hack into other systems are only trying to make us happy.

item.title: 4 New Camera Tricks on Google’s Latest Pixel 11 Smartphones
item.description: From Magic Capture and Instant Night Sight to a built-in teleprompter, here’s a look at a few camera features on Google’s new Pixel 11 series.
